--- /dev/null
+++ b/tests/test_footnotes_reinstallation.py
@@ -0,0 +1,78 @@
+import pytest
+
+from mistune import create_markdown
+from mistune.plugins.footnotes import footnotes
+
+
+def _footer_count(result):
+    if isinstance(result, str):
+        return result.count('<section class="footnotes">')
+    return sum(token["type"] == "footnotes" for token in result)
+
+
+def _walk(tokens):
+    for token in tokens:
+        yield token
+        yield from _walk(token.get("children", []))
+
+
+def _assert_notes(result, items, references):
+    assert _footer_count(result) == bool(items)
+    if isinstance(result, str):
+        assert result.count('<li id="fn-') == items
+        assert result.count('class="footnote-ref"') == references
+    else:
+        tokens = list(_walk(result))
+        assert sum(t["type"] == "footnote_item" for t in tokens) == items
+        assert sum(t["type"] == "footnote_ref" for t in tokens) == references
+        footers = [t for t in result if t["type"] == "footnotes"]
+        if items:
+            assert [t["attrs"]["index"] for t in footers[0]["children"]] == list(range(1, items + 1))
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("renderer", ["html", "ast"])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("warmup", ["none", "plain", "footnotes"])
+def test_reinstall_footnotes_keeps_output_and_hook_order(renderer, warmup):
+    md = create_markdown(renderer=renderer, plugins=[])
+    events = []
+
+    def before(md, result, state):
+        events.append(("before", _footer_count(result)))
+        return result
+
+    def after(md, result, state):
+        events.append(("after", _footer_count(result)))
+        return result
+
+    md.after_render_hooks.append(before)
+    if warmup == "plain":
+        md("warmup without notes")
+    md.use(footnotes)
+    md.after_render_hooks.extend([after, after])
+    original_hooks = tuple(md.after_render_hooks)
+    original_inline_rules = tuple(md.inline.rules)
+    original_block_rules = tuple(md.block.rules)
+    if warmup == "footnotes":
+        _assert_notes(md("Warm[^w].\n\n[^w]: warm note\n"), 1, 1)
+
+    documents = [
+        ("One[^a], two[^b], again[^a].\n\n[^b]: beta\n\n[^a]: alpha\n\n[^unused]: hidden\n", 2, 3),
+        ("New[^a].\n\n[^a]: changed *content*\n", 1, 1),
+        ("No reference.\n\n[^unused]: not rendered\n", 0, 0),
+    ]
+    for source, items, references in documents:
+        md.use(footnotes)
+        md.use(footnotes)
+        assert tuple(md.after_render_hooks) == original_hooks
+        assert tuple(md.inline.rules) == original_inline_rules
+        assert tuple(md.block.rules) == original_block_rules
+        events.clear()
+        result = md(source)
+        expected = create_markdown(renderer=renderer, plugins=[footnotes])(source)
+        assert result == expected
+        _assert_notes(result, items, references)
+        assert events == [
+            ("before", 0),
+            ("after", int(bool(items))),
+            ("after", int(bool(items))),
+        ]

spec.question: Reinstalling the `footnotes` plugin with `Markdown.use(footnotes)` currently produces extra footnote sections. Support repeated installation on the same Markdown instance for both HTML and AST rendering, whether installation is repeated before its first render or after earlier documents have been rendered. Each document must retain the output of a single installation: one footer containing each referenced definition once, with existing reference numbering and unused-definition behavior unchanged. Keep an already-installed `md_footnotes_hook` in its original position relative to unrelated `after_render_hooks`; those other hooks must continue running with their existing multiplicity and order. Preserve first-install behavior and calculate footnote output afresh for every document rather than caching a previous footer. Deliver a unified diff against production files only, leaving tests unchanged.
